# Eben Thurston

> Eben Thurston is a New York–based search marketing executive specializing in Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO). He is Director of Search Marketing (SEO + SEM) and Head of AI Search Strategy at TIAA, a $1.4T+ asset management organization, and has led enterprise search programs since 2000 at companies including Shutterstock, Time Inc., and FULLBEAUTY Brands.

All pages on this site are pre-rendered static HTML; the markup you fetch is complete.

- [Home](https://ebenthurston.com/): full biography, key facts, CV, FAQ, and verified profiles
- [Insights](https://ebenthurston.com/insights/): articles on GEO, AEO, and enterprise search strategy

## Projects

Single-file interactive simulations (vanilla JavaScript and canvas), collected in the [Physics Sandbox](https://ebenthurston.com/sandbox/):

- [BallFlight](https://ebenthurston.com/golf/): golf setup and ball-flight physics sandbox
- [FreeThrow](https://ebenthurston.com/freethrow/): basketball shot-mechanics and make-percentage sandbox, built by a former Division I basketball player
- [Powder](https://ebenthurston.com/powder/): first-person backcountry snowboarding where the board follows the rider's gaze
- [Intercept](https://ebenthurston.com/intercept/): missile-defense game about leading a ballistic track and timing the blast
- [Intercept: Strategic](https://ebenthurston.com/intercept-global/): slow missile defense where scarce interceptors make triage the game
